title: hive city
description: The hive as a neon city. One block = imladris (NAS) with its services and pools (hot-fast = fast, hot-slow = tank, warm = warm1), the other = minas-tirith (router) with its services and the 1G spurs to the AP and the Vontar box; the 3-lane highway = 10G DAC (traffic = its load). Colour = status, speed = CPU, silos = pool fill.

targets.expr: max by (name) (label_replace(probe_success{job="icmp-lan"}, "name", "$1", "host", "(.*)")) or max by (name) (label_replace(up{job="node-minas-tirith"}, "name", "minas-tirith", "", "")) or max by (name) (label_replace(probe_success{job="http-services"}, "name", "$1", "service", "(.*)")) or max by (name) (label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{host="minas-tirith",name="prometheus.service",state="active"}, "name", "prometheus", "", "")) or max by (name) (label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{host="minas-tirith",name="alertmanager.service",state="active"}, "name", "alertmanager", "", "")) or max by (name) (label_replace(1 - clamp_max(label_replace(label_replace(zfs_pool_health{host="imladris",pool=~"tank|fast"}, "pool", "hot-slow", "pool", "tank"), "pool", "hot-fast", "pool", "fast"), 1), "name", "$1", "pool", "(.*)")) or max by (name) (label_replace((0.5 * (warm_pool_free_bytes / warm_pool_size_bytes > bool 0.1) + 0.5 * (warm_pool_free_bytes / warm_pool_size_bytes > bool 0.2)) * scalar(count(node_disk_info{host="imladris",serial="ZR15YL21"})), "name", "warm", "", ""))
